turns.question: By how many euros did our average order grow from August to September 2026?
turns.answer: Average order value (non-cancelled orders' revenue over non-cancelled orders, for the whole month) was 92.25 EUR for 1-31 August 2026 and 114.39 EUR for 1-30 September 2026; I can only report these two metric figures, as the semantic layer has no metric for the difference and I do not compute figures myself. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
